name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-macos
description: Observe & operate a Mac — files, processes, apps, shell, AppleScript, GUI — safe by default.

environmentVariables.name: MACOS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Starts read-only; writes need read-write.

environmentVariables.name: MACOS_ALLOW_EXEC
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow run_command / run_applescript / kill_process (admin mode).

environmentVariables.name: MACOS_ALLOW_DELETE
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow delete_path (moves to Trash; admin mode).

environmentVariables.name: MACOS_ALLOW_INPUT
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow GUI input (type/key/click; admin mode). Needs Accessibility permission.

environmentVariables.name: MACOS_PATH_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated path roots the agent may touch (empty = anywhere; protected paths still apply).
